sections.Profile:
"Serenade" is a single-player electro-mechanical pinball machine released by Playmatic in 1969. The game features two flippers, three pop bumpers, three mushroom bumpers, two slingshots, and five kick targets.

- Manufacturer: Playmatic
- Years made: 1969
- In production: no
- Type: Electro-Mechanical
- Display: Reels
- Players: 1
- Tags: Single Player, Singing, Original Theme, Music
